class.name: ItchDataCache
class.brief_description: Lightweight cache for purchase verification results and metadata.

method.name: clear_verification
method.description: Removes cached verification data for the specified download key, if present.

method.name: get_verification_data
method.description: Returns a Dictionary containing the cached verification record for the download key. Returns an empty Dictionary if none exists.

method.name: is_verified
method.description: Returns true if the cached record marks the download key as verified.

method.name: set_verified
method.description: Sets or updates the cached verification record for a download key, including whether it is verified and any additional metadata.
